newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on low dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes firmer on low dollar demand.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,563-1,570 per dollar, a touch firmer from the morning's 1,565-1,575 due to low foreign currency demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"The lev edged up because (dollar) demand from banks and clients was low and was almost missing near the 1,570 levels in the afternoon," a bank dealer said.

The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) was seen as the main dollar buyer today, compensating the lower demand from banks and containing the lev rise, dealers said. BNB officials were not available for comment.
